description: List active deployments, optionally filtered and sorted. Use this to find deployments left running from earlier sessions before starting new ones — orphaned servers cost money. Filter by status, application, version, tags, request_id, created_at, fleet_name or host_name, e.g. [{field:"application",operator:"eq",value:"my-game"},{field:"status",operator:"eq",value:"ready"}]. Operators: eq and neq on every field except created_at (eq, gte, lte); in and nin with an array value on request_id, tags, application, version, fleet_name, host_name; ilike with % wildcards on fleet_name and host_name. At most one filter per field. Sort by created_at or available_session_sockets. To find every deployment an agent started through this server, pass only_agent_deployments: true (the same as filtering tags in ["edgegap-mcp", "mcp"]).

value.description: A string, or an array of strings for in/nin. created_at is ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-09-30T00:00:00Z".

only_agent_deployments.description: Only deployments started through this server: tagged "edgegap-mcp", or "mcp" by versions up to 0.3.3. Cannot be combined with a tags filter.

name: edgegap_list_deployments
title: List running deployments
